32/S0.subgoal: Explain the principles of user-centric design and its necessity in developing usable systems.

32/S1.subgoal: Describe the problem of design space explosion and explain why a structured approach is necessary to find the most usable design.

32/S2.subgoal: Explain the role of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) in identifying optimal designs and the need for iteration in usable systems.

32/S3.subgoal: Illustrate the iterative nature of the ISDLC and list the major stages involved.

32/S4.subgoal: Describe the requirement gathering stage, including the importance of involving end users.

32/S5.subgoal: Explain the design-prototype-evaluate loop, clarifying the role of interface and interaction design.

32/S6.subgoal: Outline the coding and testing phase, stressing the need for robust initial design to minimize rework.

32/S7.subgoal: Define and explain the necessity of empirical study (usability testing) in the interactive system development lifecycle.

32/S8.subgoal: Summarize the interactive system development lifecycle and its critical role in designing usable Extended Reality Systems.
